Kristal is proposed as inspectable representation/provenance while the Soul Causal Engine executes activation. Symbolic layers generate hypotheses rather than scientific validation, and safety remains external to simulated personality causality.

It explicitly separates established fact, reproducible observation, interpretation and testable hypothesis; its current decoding kernel is exploratory rather than established physics.

components.label: Power Dynamics
